questions.q: What does this lesson say about handing you "the real exam" for a ServiceNow technical screening?
options: It provides the exact questions every ServiceNow employer asks
Technical screenings never vary between companies or roles
No two screens ask identical questions, so this lesson gives a preparation framework instead of a leaked question list
ServiceNow technical screens are standardized across every company
questions.explain: The lesson is explicit that specific questions vary; what stays stable are the three things being assessed.

questions.q: Why does the "spot the problem in this GlideRecord query" question type come up often?
options: It tests real fluency rather than memorized syntax
It is the only question type interviewers are allowed to ask
It has nothing to do with scripting ability
It only tests typing speed
questions.explain: Reading and diagnosing existing code demonstrates genuine fluency in a way reciting definitions does not.

questions.q: What is a scenario like "a business unit wants a new approval step added to a workflow used by twelve other departments" mainly testing?
options: Whether you've memorized every ServiceNow system property
Whether you instinctively consider blast radius, testing, and rollback before the mechanics of the change
Whether you can recite the exact steps to add an approval node from memory
Your typing speed while configuring a workflow
questions.explain: This question type is testing architecture judgment against a specific context, not a single memorized correct answer.

questions.q: What does the question "tell me about a technical decision you made and why" assess, according to this lesson?
options: Whether you remember every certification exam topic
Only how long you've worked with ServiceNow
Whether you can state the context, name an alternative you didn't choose, and give a specific, defensible reason
Nothing meaningful — it's treated as pure small talk
questions.explain: This is the same skill trained by the capstone's Architecture Decision Record exercise and Chapter 6's defense practice.

questions.q: What preparation does this lesson recommend since there's no fixed exam to cram for?
options: Avoid preparing since technical screens can't be prepared for
Review your own portfolio artifacts and rehearse stating what each does, an alternative considered, and why you chose what you built
Memorize a list of trick questions found online
Only study certification exam study guides
questions.explain: Rehearsing the context-alternative-reason structure on your own real artifacts prepares you for exactly what gets tested.
